board.title: Workspace · G · My region, one list with the club beside it (round 2)
board.name: My region · list with the club beside it
board.idea: My region is one list of the region's clubs with what needs doing at the top; a club opens in a panel beside the list (Listing · Tonight · News · Events), so the representative works through nine clubs without leaving the page.
board.differs: Work-G keeps the club beside the list in a side panel; Work-H gives each club a card that opens its own full page.

drawn.title: Workspace · G · My region, one list with the club beside it (round 2)
drawn.second_title: Workspace · G-2 · My region, the panel tabs, email and states (round 2)
drawn.note:
What: My region at /workspace/region, shown on Mon, Oct 5, 2026 at 8:40 AM. It is one list of the nine clubs Chris Arceneaux keeps as South Central Louisiana representative, with the Needs doing cards on top: the monthly check, 4 clubs not checked in 90 days, and 2 reports waiting. The chosen club (Houma) opens in a sticky panel beside the list, with the tabs Listing · Tonight · News · Events. Work-G-2 holds the Tonight, News and Events tabs, the monthly email on a phone (Mon, Nov 2), the states, and the way in and back. Work-H is the other option: a card for each club that opens the club's own page.

Built from: Work-B (freshness check, visitor reports, the Tonight switch, the listing editor, club news, the page checklist), replan 3.3, 3.4 and 4.2, Account-M's nine-club region data, and the decided signed-in header and footer. Drawn inside Int-A, and the frame can be swapped: the legend gives the three crumbs (My LCA › My region · My LCA rail › My region · My LCA › Your work › My region).

K's feedback applied: the working screen is now joined to the whole. The way in is the Your region section's Open My region, the Today item and the menu row 'My region · 4 to check'. Every screen carries the crumb 'My LCA › My region' and Back to My LCA. Work-B's club rep framing, its Members tab, the computed schedule and 'Suggest for LCA News' are gone. Open for K: G or H; question 20 (may a club's own rep edit its listing in this same panel); confirm that Lafayette Open 2026 is a partner event and so shows no count.
unresolved: The spec gives Lafayette Open 2026 as 'published · 31 registered · TD named', but the decided Tourn-List-Final calls it a partner event, and the copy rules say a partner event never gets a count. The row reads 'Lafayette Open 2026 · Sat–Sun, Oct 10–11 · Partner event' with no count and no TD. This is listed under Open for K.

Frame A is drawn at 1440 with the list at 872px and the panel at 500px (the spec says 860 and 520), so that the seven list columns fit. To keep the board under 3000px, the region filter chips are shortened to South Central · Central · Bayou.

The spec wanted everything on one board, but it measured 4424px, so it is split. Work-G (2936px rendered, declared 2950) holds the title strip, the legend and Frame A. Work-G-2 (2215px rendered, declared 2250) holds insets G1 to G3, Frame B (the monthly email), the states and the way-in inset.

The left column under the clubs list has some empty space next to the taller sticky panel. A dashed note badged 1 sits there to explain the sticky panel. It was left that way on purpose, not padded with invented content.

These details are invented and covered by the Sample data badge: the club colours and initials logos, Houma's longer statement, venue fields, reply text and past news posts, and the 'Checked Oct 2026' months in the Nov 2 email. Work-G-2's states also gain a 'report at 14 days' state (Sat, Oct 10) that the spec did not list.

review.counts: Work-G renders at 2936px, declared as 2950 (root and $preview). Work-G-2 rendered at 2339px after the menu fix, so I raised it from 2250 to 2350. Both are under the 3000 limit. Legend: 6 numbered notes on each part. Design badges: Work-G has 1 to 6; Work-G-2 has 2, 3, 4 and 5. Region data matches the spec and Work-H. Nine clubs are listed: 5 in South Central, 2 in Central, 2 in Bayou. 4 are amber with "Not checked since Jun 2026" in words. There are 2 open reports (Houma, 9 days; Bunkie, 1 day), 1 event in LCA review (Baton Rouge November Saturday G/90), and the next monthly check is Mon, Nov 2. I checked 13 dates against their weekdays and all are right, including Wed, Jun 30, 2027 and Mon, Aug 17. Em dashes: 0. {{holes}}: 0. Iframes and animation: none. Tags are balanced in both files. No USCF, no .5, no grade, birthdate or financial-need question. Gold is used only as fill, border or underline; gold-ink text uses #866a1e. Header and footer markup match Tourn-List-Final. The My LCA count is 1. The menu rows now match Work-H: To do · 1, My LCA, Family, Membership card, Events you direct (3), My region · 4 to check, Board inbox (3), Support tickets (4), Log out. "Admin" appears only as a destination for lca_admin, the Workspace word is not in the drawn chrome, and there is no mode switch. Not drawn: members list, roster, sign-in QR, computed next meeting, Tonight state as a fact, freshness badge. The only overflow left is the intended note badges set at -12px on two Needs doing cards.
changes: Work-G: the club list no longer cuts the 'How it meets' statement at two lines with an ellipsis. Houma's statement lost 'Library' and Baton Rouge lost 'Saturdays 10:00 AM ... G/90+30'. The rows grow to fit and the page height does not change, because the panel sets it.
Work-G: the 'Open' tags now read '1 report · 9 days' and '1 suggestion · 1 day' with a non-breaking space. Before, they broke as '9 / days'.
Work-G: the visitor's quote in the panel now reads 'closes at 8:00 PM ... until 8:30 PM?' instead of '8 PM' and '8:30?', to follow the 7:00 PM rule.
Work-G: Lafayette Open 2026 is a partner event on Tourn-List-Final. Its row now carries the link 'Registers on the organizer's site ↗' under 'Partner event', with no count and no Register button.
Work-G: Frame A's heading now reads 'the list stays, Houma Chess Club opens in the panel beside it', so the difference from Work-H is visible at a glance.

Work-G-2: the My LCA menu inset was missing two rows. It now has the 'To do · 1' row (Pay $20 · Ella's November Meet entry) and 'Log out', so it matches the frame's menu order and Work-H. Height raised from 2250 to 2350, in both the root and $preview.
remaining_concerns: Lafayette Open status conflict: the spec's region data gives the Lafayette Open '31 registered · TD named', which makes it an LCA event. The decided boards make it a partner event. Work-G follows the decided boards and puts the question to K under Open for K. Account-M and Account-N still draw '31 registered' for it, which breaks the partner rule on those boards. I did not edit them, because they are outside this review.
Work-H-2 (the sibling, not in this review) still quotes the visitor as 'closes at 8 PM ... until 8:30?'. Its reviewer should change it to '8:00 PM ... 8:30 PM?' to match Work-G.
Column widths: the spec asks for a list 860 wide and a panel 520 wide. The board draws 872 and 500. The difference is small and nothing clips, so I left it.

Monthly email date: the inset is dated Mon, Nov 2 but still shows Houma's report open (37 days old by then). It also shows Baton Rouge and Lafayette as last checked in September. The caption explains that the report row is shown on purpose. The months are sample data and plausible.

board.title: Workspace · H · My region, a card per club, each its own page (round 2)
board.name: My region · a card per club
board.idea: My region is a board of nine club cards, each stamped with its state in words; a card opens the club's own page at /workspace/region/clubs/:id with the editor at full width, so each club is a place of its own with a stable link.
board.differs: Work-H opens each club as its own full page from a card; Work-G keeps the club in a side panel beside one list.

drawn.title: Workspace · H · My region, a card per club, each its own page (round 2)
drawn.second_title: Workspace · H-2 · My region, the club's own page and the monthly email (round 2)
drawn.note:
What: My region at /workspace/region is a board of nine club cards. Each card shows its state in words, such as "Not checked since Jun 2026", "1 report · 9 days" or "Event in LCA review". Each card has a one-tap "Still accurate" button, which reads "Answer it, then confirm" while a report or suggestion is open, and an Open button. Open takes you to the club's own page at /workspace/region/clubs/:id (part 2). That page has the editor at full width with the live club card, the search-result preview, the page checklist and the visitor report banner, plus the Tonight, News and Events tabs as insets. Part 2 also has the Mon, Nov 2 monthly email on a phone and the states (empty, the day the check lands, a thin club, no seat). Part 1 shows the way in from My LCA (the Your region section, the Today item, the menu row "My region · 4 to check") and the way back.

Built from: Work-B (the accuracy check, visitor reports, the Tonight notice, the editor with its live card, club news, club events behind LCA review, the page checklist), the replan's My region text (DESIGN_REPLAN_phase2.md 3.3, 3.4 and 4.2), the nine-club region data shared with Work-G and Account-M and N, and the decided header and footer from Tourn-List-Final and Nav-Header-Final. Drawn inside Int-A, and the frame is swappable: the legend shows the crumb under Int-A, Int-B and Int-C.

K's feedback applied: page 15, "integrate each of them into the whole and also get mockup options for each". The club rep workspace becomes the representative's room, opened from My LCA, with "My LCA › My region › Houma Chess Club" and a Back link on every screen. There is no members list and the word Workspace never appears. Work-H is one option and Work-G (the club in a side panel) is the other. Open for K: Work-G or Work-H; Question 20 (if the club's own rep stays as its author, they would open this same club page for their one club); whether to keep the Tonight notice the representative posts by hand.
unresolved: The shared region data gives Lafayette Chess Club 'Lafayette Open 2026 · published · 31 registered · TD named', but the decided Tourn-List-Final shows the Lafayette Open as a partner event. Partner events never get a count, so the Lafayette card has no event stamp. The shared data and Work-G may need correcting to match.

The spec asks for Frames A, B and C plus the states, the way-in inset and the legend on one board under 3000px. That did not fit, so it is split into two boards. Work-H holds the title strip, the legend, Frame A and the way-in inset. Work-H-2 holds Frame B (the club page with insets H1 to H3), Frame C (the phone email) and the states strip. Both are 1440 by 2950. Rendered content is 2913px on Work-H and 2944px on Work-H-2.
Cards are 424px wide, not the spec's 440, because the room sits inside a 1360px browser frame on a fixed 1440 board.
The phone in Frame C is cropped to 736px tall (390 wide) so Work-H-2 stays under 3000px; the whole email still fits on the screen.

In the club page header, 'Still accurate' is drawn disabled with the words 'Answer the report first', because Houma's report is open. This follows the spec's rule that a report blocks the confirm until it is answered.
Invented content carries a Sample data badge: the statement text, the field values, the photos, the past news posts, the 14 followers, the club colours and the Thu, Oct 15 empty-state date.

review.counts:
I rendered both boards at 1440 with the height set to auto. Work-H comes out at 2935px and Work-H-2 at 2944px, so the declared 2950 (root and $preview) is right for both and under the 3000 limit.

Legends: 6 numbered notes on each board, and every badge drawn on the design maps to one of them. Work-H has badges 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6. Work-H-2 has badges 1 to 6.

Cards: 9 club cards in a 3 by 3 grid, sorted Bunkie, Gonzales, Heart of Worship, Pineville, Houma, then Baton Rouge, Bluebonnet, Lafayette and Morgan City. That matches the spec order.
- 4 amber stamps reading 'Not checked since Jun 2026', each with a clock mark and the words.
- 3 open-item stamps: Houma '1 report · 9 days', Bunkie '1 suggestion · 1 day', Baton Rouge 'Event in LCA review'.
- 2 cards (Bunkie and Houma) have 'Still accurate' disabled and reading 'Answer it, then confirm'.
- 3 clubs read 'Schedule not listed · Suggest an update' (Gonzales, Lafayette, Morgan City).

Routes: /workspace/region and /workspace/region/clubs/houma-chess-club. The three breadcrumbs (Int-A, Int-B /my/..., Int-C /work/...) and the frame line are in both legends.

Header and menu: the header matches Tourn-List-Final. Work-H-2 uses the decided tight version (rook only, short Search), which Nav-Header-Final sets for 1024 to 1279px. The My LCA count is 1. The menu rows (Pay $20 for Ella's November Meet entry, My LCA, Family, Membership card, Events you direct (3), My region · 4 to check, Board inbox (3), Support tickets (4), Log out) and the rail rows (3, 4, 7) match Account-G, Account-M and Work-G-2. There is no Admin row and no mode switch. The word Workspace appears only in URLs and the board title.

Way in and back:
- In: the Your region section with 'Open My region', the Today item ending 'Check the four', and the menu row.
- Back: 'Back to My LCA' on the room, and the club page's crumb 'My LCA › My region › Houma Chess Club' with 'Back to My region'.

Rules checked by script on the visible text: 0 em dashes, 0 dates without a weekday, 0 times without minutes, 0 'USCF', 0 '.5', 0 AI references, 0 grade, birthdate or financial-need questions. Gold #c8a94a is only used as a fill or border, never as text on a light ground. Each board has a Sample data badge.

Spec content: no members list, no computed next meeting, and no Tonight state shown as a fact. The Tonight tab is a notice the representative sets by hand. The 'Checked Sep 2026' stamps are the dates the representative confirmed, not freshness badges.

All 9 dates on the board fall on the weekdays given: Mon, Oct 5; Sat, Sep 26; Sun, Oct 4; Mon, Nov 2; Thu, Oct 15; Mon, Aug 17; Tue, Aug 18; Mon, Aug 31; Wed, Jun 30, 2027.

Structure: no unclosed or mismatched tags in either file, no {{holes}}, no iframes, no animation, and the skeleton matches an existing board.

Note for the canvas sticky (from the board): 'My region as nine club cards stamped in words; a card opens the club's own page at /workspace/region/clubs/:id with the editor at full width (part 2, Work-H-2). Option H against Work-G, which keeps the club in a side panel beside one list. Drawn inside Int-A; the frame is swappable.'
changes: Work-H.dc.html: the two disabled 'Answer it, then confirm' buttons now carry disabled="disabled", so every attribute is quoted as the file rules require.
Work-H-2.dc.html: 'Answer the report first' now carries disabled="disabled" and the Tonight checkbox checked="checked", for the same reason.

Work-H-2.dc.html: the Tonight tab's 'On as usual · Moved · Cancelled' switch in inset H1 did not fill its 300px box. It now spans the full width, and 'On as usual' stays on one line. I checked this in a fresh render.
Heights unchanged: both boards still render under the declared 2950 (2935 and 2944).
remaining_concerns: Frame B shows the club header's 'Still accurate' button disabled as 'Answer the report first', because Houma has an open report. The spec's header list names 'Still accurate'. I kept it disabled because it matches the card rule ('a report or suggestion blocks it until answered').

Work-H-2's monthly email (Mon, Nov 2) still shows Houma's report open, 37 days after it came in and past the 14-day point where it also goes to the admins. This matches Work-G-2 deliberately, so I did not change it, but K may find it odd.

The shared data's Lafayette Open (published, 31 registered, TD named) is not drawn on Lafayette's card. Other boards treat it as a partner event, and partner events never carry a count. The board's grey note says so. The spec only asks for stamps on Houma, Bunkie and Baton Rouge, so this agrees with it.

Bunkie's suggestion text ('The club moved to the Bunkie Public Library') does not appear on Work-H. Only its stamp does, because the opened club drawn is Houma. That is correct for this layout but differs from Work-G, which quotes the suggestion.

board.title: Admin · I · The queue is the home (round 2)

drawn.title: Admin · I · The queue is the home (round 2)
drawn.second_title: Admin · I-2 · The way in, the backstop, the states (round 2)
drawn.note:
What: /admin opens straight on the merged Needs attention queue. It is one table over six sources (Support, Board inbox, Approvals, Failed emails, Club listing reports, Partner reports), and each row shows its owner, how long it has waited and one action. The sidebar is grouped: Needs attention, Members, Tournaments, Clubs, Content, Board, Email, Site, Audit. The banner, automations, membership switch, audit log and Log in as now sit in their sidebar groups, and a one-line Today strip says whether any of them need a look. Part 2 (Work-I-2) draws the TD-console backstop, Log in as, the way in from My LCA and back, and the empty and busy states. Work-J is the other option: its home is a dashboard with the queue's top five.

Built from: Work-C (queue, count tiles, weekday 7:00 AM digest, self-expiring banner, automations, Log in as with a reason), WS08 as amended by replan 4.6, Account-Q and Q-2 (queue data, backstop strip, menu row), Work-A's console band, and the decided header and footer (Nav-Header-Final, Tourn-List-Final). Drawn inside Int-A. The frame is swappable, and the three breadcrumbs are in the legend.

K's feedback applied: Admin is joined to the whole. You get in from the My LCA menu row "Admin · 12 need attention" or the LCA admin section's Open Admin. The crumb reads My LCA › Admin, and Back to My LCA sits in the crumb line and under the sidebar title. The word is Admin, never Admin panel. The club rep request row, champion submissions and the old "Club listings" source are gone. Open for K: pick I or J; officers and the president get rooms (drawn) or keep one "Admin (view only)" row; may Assign offer an officer for support tickets; Exit console from the backstop goes to Admin › Tournaments (drawn) or to My LCA.

'Waiting 2+ days 5' is drawn as 6, because six rows have waited 2 days or more (9d, 6d, 4d, 3d, 2d, 2d). Work-J will need the same correction: its 'Assigned to you · 3: rows 3, 4 and 6' also counts Chris's row.

The board would not fit under 3200px with every inset the spec lists, so it is split in two. Work-I (3100) holds the title strip, Frame A, I1 Review, I2 Site and the no-second-factor state. Work-I-2 (1600) holds I3 backstop, I4 Log in as, the way in and back, and the empty and busy states. The spec did not name a second board.

The admin's name follows the spec (Denise Fontenot, Sample data). Account-Q draws the same admin seat as Rachel Boudreaux, who appears here as the second admin in the Assign picker. The two boards should settle on one person.
The source names follow the spec's removes field and Account-Q: 'Club listing reports' for the spec's 'Club reports' and 'Partner reports' (partner listing reports) for its 'Listing reports'.
